description: Create a Mother's Day gift wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. If storage is token, later mutations may return a new id — always use the latest. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es (mothers day / mors dag / Muttertag / fête des mères / día de la madre)

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, us, se, de. Recommended: pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (US catalog, English, USD, tag sw-mothersday-20) and amazon.se for Sweden (SE catalog, tag sw-mothersday-21). If omitted: Accept-Language en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se. Other storefronts get Mother's Day search links.

name: create_wishlist
title: Create Mother's Day gift list
